releaseNotes.zh: 助手界面更简洁，按钮和面板配色更柔和，保留清晰反馈与足够点击面积。历史、新对话和当前任务控制更易找到，操作详情与撤销分开。需要邀请码；请覆盖安装以保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: Simpler Agent navigation, softer buttons with clear touch feedback. Easier access to history, new chats and task controls, with separate details and undo. Invite required; install over the existing app to keep local data.
